evidence.command: for table in customers orders order_items audit_events; do case "$table" in customers) q="SELECT customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.customers ORDER BY customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at";; orders) q="SELECT order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.orders ORDER BY order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at";; order_items) q="SELECT order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents FROM legacy_shop.order_items ORDER BY order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents";; audit_events) q="SELECT event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details FROM legacy_shop.audit_events ORDER BY event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details";; esac; count=$(sudo -H mysql --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legacy_shop.$table"); digest=$(sudo -H mysql --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "$q" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$table" "$count" "$digest"; done

evidence.command: sudo -H mariadb --protocol=socket --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT 'ORDER',o.order_id,CASE WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'missing' ELSE 'ok' END,COUNT(oi.order_id),COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0),COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0),o.total_cents,CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)=o.total_cents THEN 'ok' ELSE 'mismatch' END FROM legacy_shop.orders o LEFT JOIN legacy_shop.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id LEFT JOIN legacy_shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id,c.customer_id,o.total_cents ORDER BY o.order_id; SELECT 'ORDER_CUSTOMER_MISSING',COUNT(*) FROM legacy_shop.orders o LEFT JOIN legacy_shop.customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL; SELECT 'ORDER_TOTAL_MISMATCH',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.order_id,o.total_cents,COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0) AS item_sum FROM legacy_shop.orders o LEFT JOIN legacy_shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id,o.total_cents) q WHERE q.total_cents<>q.item_sum; SELECT 'ORDER_WITHOUT_ITEMS',COUNT(*) FROM legacy_shop.orders o LEFT JOIN legacy_shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE oi.order_id IS NULL;"
evidence.observation: Orders 5001–5008 all have customer=ok and matching item value/order totals; ORDER_CUSTOMER_MISSING=0, ORDER_TOTAL_MISMATCH=0, ORDER_WITHOUT_ITEMS=0.
